attempts_check_3.name: attempts_check_3
attempts_check_3.value: original_question_id IS NULL OR original_question_id != question_id

confirmed_results_check_2.name: confirmed_results_check_2
confirmed_results_check_2.value: performance IN ('미확인','설명 필요','도움받아 수행','독립 수행','지연 재현')

cost_reservations_check_2.name: cost_reservations_check_2
cost_reservations_check_2.value: actual_units IS NULL OR (actual_units >= 0 AND actual_units <= amount_units)

external_steps_check_3.name: external_steps_check_3
external_steps_check_3.value: state != 'confirmed' OR (external_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence IS NOT NULL)

materials_check_2.name: materials_check_2
materials_check_2.value: origin != 'google' OR (original_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at IS NOT NULL)

quota_reservations_check_2.name: quota_reservations_check_2
quota_reservations_check_2.value: actual_units IS NULL OR (actual_units >= 0 AND actual_units <= weight)

ai_pricing_snapshot.name: ai_pricing_snapshot
ai_pricing_snapshot.value: json_valid(snapshot) AND json_extract(snapshot,'$.id') = id AND json_extract(snapshot,'$.model') = 'gpt-6-luna'

material_inventory_evidence.name: material_inventory_evidence
material_inventory_evidence.value: json_valid(evidence) AND blocked IN (0,1) AND valid_until > checked_at

material_transfer_object.name: material_transfer_object
material_transfer_object.value: write_status != 'succeeded' OR (object_version IS NOT NULL AND etag IS NOT NULL AND actual_hash IS NOT NULL AND actual_bytes IS NOT NULL AND actual_hash = json_extract(metadata,'$.sha256') AND actual_bytes = json_extract(metadata,'$.bytes'))

material_transfer_confirmed.name: material_transfer_confirmed
material_transfer_confirmed.value: state NOT IN ('verified','registered') OR (write_status = 'succeeded' AND validation IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(validation,'$.objectVersion') = object_version AND json_extract(validation,'$.etag') = etag AND json_extract(validation,'$.sha256') = actual_hash AND json_extract(validation,'$.bytes') = actual_bytes)

material_transfer_cleanup.name: material_transfer_cleanup
material_transfer_cleanup.value: state NOT IN ('cleaning','discarded') OR write_status IN ('not-started','succeeded','aborted')

extraction_job_selection.name: extraction_job_selection
extraction_job_selection.value: json_valid(selection) AND json_extract(selection,'$.materialId')=id AND json_array_length(selection,'$.pages') BETWEEN 1 AND 20

extraction_page_version.name: extraction_page_version
extraction_page_version.value: typeof(version)='integer' AND version>=1 AND selection_revision>=1 AND file_page BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND result_version>=0

extraction_page_result.name: extraction_page_result
extraction_page_result.value: (result_version=0 AND result_id IS NULL) OR (result_version>0 AND result_id IS NOT NULL)

extraction_page_pending.name: extraction_page_pending
extraction_page_pending.value: state NOT IN ('running','unknown') OR (pending_ai_key IS NOT NULL AND pending_image IS NOT NULL)

extraction_result_ai.name: extraction_result_ai
extraction_result_ai.value: json_extract(result,'$.method')!='vision' OR (ai_call_id IS NOT NULL AND image IS NOT NULL)

advisor_event_valid.name: advisor_event_valid
advisor_event_valid.value: json_valid(content) AND version>=1 AND kind IN ('start','answer','begin','turn','plan','edit','confirm')

advisor_state_valid.name: advisor_state_valid
advisor_state_valid.value: json_valid(state) AND json_extract(state,'$.id')=id AND json_extract(state,'$.version')=version AND version>=1

librarian_link_content.name: librarian_link_content
librarian_link_content.value: json_valid(content) AND json_extract(content,'$.id')=id AND json_extract(content,'$.planVersionId')=plan_version_id AND json_extract(content,'$.unitId')=unit_id AND json_extract(content,'$.materialId')=material_id

study_scope_state.name: study_scope_state
study_scope_state.value: json_valid(state) AND version>=1 AND json_extract(state,'$.version')=version AND json_extract(state,'$.input.id')=id AND json_extract(state,'$.input.planVersionId')=plan_version_id AND json_extract(state,'$.input.unitId')=unit_id

review_schedule_values.name: review_schedule_values
review_schedule_values.value: version>=1 AND review_version>=1 AND kind IN ('variable','delayed-recall') AND state IN ('pending','complete') AND length(due_date)=10

tutor_session_state.name: tutor_session_state
tutor_session_state.value: json_valid(state) AND version>=1 AND json_extract(state,'$.version')=version AND json_extract(state,'$.id')=id AND json_extract(state,'$.start.scopeId')=scope_id

google_oauth_lifetime.name: google_oauth_lifetime
google_oauth_lifetime.value: created_at>=0 AND expires_at>created_at AND expires_at-created_at<=600000 AND (consumed_at IS NULL OR (consumed_at>=created_at AND consumed_at<expires_at))

google_oauth_purpose.name: google_oauth_purpose
google_oauth_purpose.value: (purpose='connect' AND connection_id IS NULL AND connection_generation IS NULL) OR (purpose='reconnect' AND length(connection_id)=36 AND connection_generation>=1)

google_picker_lifetime.name: google_picker_lifetime
google_picker_lifetime.value: generation>=1 AND issued_at>=0 AND expires_at>issued_at AND expires_at-issued_at<=60000

google_provider_block_data.name: google_provider_block_data
google_provider_block_data.value: policy_version>=1 AND blocked_at>=0 AND (blocked_until IS NULL OR blocked_until>blocked_at) AND reason IN ('quota','storage-full','api-disabled')

google_request_data.name: google_request_data
google_request_data.value: generation>=1 AND policy_version>=1 AND length(request_hash)=64 AND reserved_at>=0 AND expires_at>reserved_at AND storage_bytes>=0 AND storage_bytes<=10485760

google_resource_source.name: google_resource_source
google_resource_source.value: source IN ('picker','app-created') AND (role!='calendar-target' OR (source='app-created' AND external_id!='primary'))

google_runtime_lease.name: google_runtime_lease
google_runtime_lease.value: (state='refreshing' AND refresh_lease_id IS NOT NULL AND refresh_lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR (state!='refreshing' AND refresh_lease_id IS NULL AND refresh_lease_expires_at IS NULL)

external_attempt_record_identity.name: external_attempt_record_identity
external_attempt_record_identity.value: ordinal>=1 AND lease_epoch>=1 AND length(lease_id)=36 AND mode IN ('write','verify')

external_attempt_record_state.name: external_attempt_record_state
external_attempt_record_state.value: state IN ('started','received','verified','failed','unknown','conflict','not-sent') AND ((state='started' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (state!='started' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at>=started_at))

external_attempt_record_evidence.name: external_attempt_record_evidence
external_attempt_record_evidence.value: started_at>=0 AND (status_code IS NULL OR (status_code>=100 AND status_code<=599)) AND (error IS NULL OR json_valid(error)) AND (verification IS NULL OR json_valid(verification)) AND (state!='verified' OR (verification IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(json_extract(verification,'$.status'),'')='matched'))

external_operation_data.name: external_operation_data
external_operation_data.value: version>=1 AND ordinal>=1 AND ordinal<=40 AND length(kind)>0 AND length(business_key)>0 AND length(request_hash)=64 AND length(expected_hash)=64 AND json_valid(snapshot) AND attempt_count>=0 AND lease_epoch>=0 AND next_attempt_at>=0

external_operation_lease.name: external_operation_lease
external_operation_lease.value: (state='running' AND lease_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch>=1) OR (state!='running' AND lease_id IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL)

external_operation_times.name: external_operation_times
external_operation_times.value: (intent_at IS NULL OR intent_at>=0) AND (response_at IS NULL OR (intent_at IS NOT NULL AND response_at>=intent_at))

external_operation_evidence.name: external_operation_evidence
external_operation_evidence.value: (verification IS NULL OR json_valid(verification)) AND (last_error IS NULL OR json_valid(last_error)) AND (state!='received' OR response_at IS NOT NULL) AND (state!='confirmed' OR (external_id IS NOT NULL AND verification IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(json_extract(verification,'$.status'),'')='matched' AND coalesce(json_extract(verification,'$.expectedHash'),'')=expected_hash AND coalesce(json_extract(verification,'$.checkedAt'),-1)>=0))

external_request_key_data.name: external_request_key_data
external_request_key_data.value: length(request_key)>0 AND length(request_key)<=200 AND length(request_hash)=64 AND created_at>=0

external_workflow_identity.name: external_workflow_identity
external_workflow_identity.value: version>=1 AND generation>=1 AND kind IN ('weekly-export','calendar') AND length(target_key)>0 AND length(source_version)>0 AND length(google_subject)>0

external_workflow_snapshot.name: external_workflow_snapshot
external_workflow_snapshot.value: length(request_hash)=64 AND json_valid(snapshot) AND created_at>=0 AND deadline_at>created_at

google_reference_state.name: google_reference_state
google_reference_state.value: generation>=1 AND state IN ('reading','verified','failed') AND ((state='reading' AND proof IS NULL AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (state='failed' AND proof IS NULL AND finished_at>=created_at) OR (state='verified' AND json_valid(proof) AND finished_at>=created_at))

backup_object_values.name: backup_object_values
backup_object_values.value: "backup_objects"."ordinal" BETWEEN 0 AND 9999 AND "backup_objects"."bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 268435456 AND length("backup_objects"."sha256")=64 AND "backup_objects"."verified_at">=0 AND ("backup_objects"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL OR "backup_objects"."acknowledged_at">="backup_objects"."verified_at")

backup_page_bounds.name: backup_page_bounds
backup_page_bounds.value: "backup_pages"."ordinal" BETWEEN 0 AND 9999 AND "backup_pages"."cursor_before" >= 0 AND "backup_pages"."cursor_after" >= "backup_pages"."cursor_before" AND "backup_pages"."row_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 32 AND "backup_pages"."bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 AND length("backup_pages"."sha256") = 64 AND "backup_pages"."final" IN (0,1)

restore_archive_state.name: restore_archive_state
restore_archive_state.value: ("restore_archives"."state"='reserved' AND "restore_archives"."object_version" IS NULL AND "restore_archives"."ready_at" IS NULL) OR ("restore_archives"."state"='ready' AND "restore_archives"."object_version" IS NOT NULL AND length("restore_archives"."object_version")>0 AND "restore_archives"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "restore_archives"."ready_at">="restore_archives"."created_at")

restore_challenge_time.name: restore_challenge_time
restore_challenge_time.value: "restore_challenges"."issued_at">=0 AND "restore_challenges"."expires_at">"restore_challenges"."issued_at" AND "restore_challenges"."expires_at"-"restore_challenges"."issued_at"<=900000 AND (("restore_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "restore_challenges"."consumed_run_id" IS NULL) OR ("restore_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "restore_challenges"."consumed_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "restore_challenges"."consumed_at">="restore_challenges"."issued_at" AND "restore_challenges"."consumed_at"<"restore_challenges"."expires_at"))

restore_google_read_quota.name: restore_google_read_quota
restore_google_read_quota.value: "restore_google_reads"."policy_version">0 AND json_valid("restore_google_reads"."policy") AND json_valid("restore_google_reads"."charges") AND length(CAST("restore_google_reads"."policy" AS BLOB))<=65536 AND length(CAST("restore_google_reads"."charges" AS BLOB))<=16384 AND "restore_google_reads"."reserved_at">=0 AND "restore_google_reads"."expires_at">"restore_google_reads"."reserved_at"

restore_google_read_state.name: restore_google_read_state
restore_google_read_state.value: ("restore_google_reads"."state"='reserved' AND "restore_google_reads"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "restore_google_reads"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("restore_google_reads"."state"='sending' AND "restore_google_reads"."sent_at">="restore_google_reads"."reserved_at" AND "restore_google_reads"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("restore_google_reads"."state" IN ('succeeded','failed','unknown') AND "restore_google_reads"."sent_at">="restore_google_reads"."reserved_at" AND "restore_google_reads"."finished_at">="restore_google_reads"."sent_at")

restore_import_page_data.name: restore_import_page_data
restore_import_page_data.value: "restore_import_pages"."sequence" BETWEEN 0 AND 9999 AND "restore_import_pages"."row_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 32 AND "restore_import_pages"."loaded_at">=0

restore_import_progress.name: restore_import_progress
restore_import_progress.value: "restore_imports"."expected_pages" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "restore_imports"."loaded_pages" BETWEEN 0 AND "restore_imports"."expected_pages" AND "restore_imports"."started_at">=0

restore_original_plan.name: restore_original_plan
restore_original_plan.value: json_valid("restore_originals"."plan") AND json_valid("restore_originals"."source_pages") AND length(CAST("restore_originals"."plan" AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND "restore_originals"."ordinal" BETWEEN 0 AND 9999

restore_original_state.name: restore_original_state
restore_original_state.value: ("restore_originals"."state"='reserved' AND "restore_originals"."object_version" IS NULL AND "restore_originals"."etag" IS NULL AND "restore_originals"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("restore_originals"."state"='verified' AND "restore_originals"."object_version" IS NOT NULL AND length("restore_originals"."object_version")>0 AND "restore_originals"."etag" IS NOT NULL AND length("restore_originals"."etag")>0 AND "restore_originals"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "restore_originals"."verified_at">="restore_originals"."created_at")

restore_reconciliation_result.name: restore_reconciliation_result
restore_reconciliation_result.value: ("restore_reconciliations"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "restore_reconciliations"."proof" IS NULL) OR ("restore_reconciliations"."finished_at">="restore_reconciliations"."started_at" AND "restore_reconciliations"."proof" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("restore_reconciliations"."proof") AND length(CAST("restore_reconciliations"."proof" AS BLOB))<=4096)

restore_run_authorization.name: restore_run_authorization
restore_run_authorization.value: json_valid("restore_runs"."authorization") AND length(CAST("restore_runs"."authorization" AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND "restore_runs"."started_at">=0

restore_storage_identity.name: restore_storage_identity
restore_storage_identity.value: json_valid("restore_storage"."identity") AND length(CAST("restore_storage"."identity" AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048

restore_storage_state.name: restore_storage_state
restore_storage_state.value: ("restore_storage"."state"='reserved' AND "restore_storage"."marker_version" IS NULL AND "restore_storage"."marker_bytes" IS NULL AND "restore_storage"."ready_at" IS NULL) OR ("restore_storage"."state"='ready' AND "restore_storage"."marker_version" IS NOT NULL AND length("restore_storage"."marker_version")>0 AND "restore_storage"."marker_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "restore_storage"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "restore_storage"."marker_bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "restore_storage"."ready_at">="restore_storage"."created_at")

restore_verification_item.name: restore_verification_item
restore_verification_item.value: "restore_verification_items"."verified_at">=0 AND length("restore_verification_items"."sha256")=64 AND (("restore_verification_items"."kind"='page' AND "restore_verification_items"."projected_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND length("restore_verification_items"."projected_sha256")=64 AND "restore_verification_items"."object_version" IS NULL) OR ("restore_verification_items"."kind"='original' AND "restore_verification_items"."projected_sha256" IS NULL AND "restore_verification_items"."object_version" IS NOT NULL AND length("restore_verification_items"."object_version")>0))

restore_verification_bounds.name: restore_verification_bounds
restore_verification_bounds.value: "restore_verifications"."revision">=0 AND "restore_verifications"."page_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "restore_verifications"."object_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "restore_verifications"."row_count">=0 AND "restore_verifications"."started_at">=0 AND ("restore_verifications"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "restore_verifications"."completed_at">="restore_verifications"."started_at")
